blurb: Guests experience tandem skydiving with USPA-rated and FAA certified instructors, including ground instruction and equipment. They can choose from standard tandem jumps, an ultimate adventurer experience with parachute deployment, or a helicopter tandem skydive with scenic flight. Training programs for solo skydiving and A-License certification are also offered.
